contests.title: City of Austin Proposition I — Affordability and efficiency reviews

provenance.quote:
Shall the City Charter be amended
to require an Independent
Affordability and Efficiency Initiative
on a regular basis and before any
tax rate increase election and
requiring the independent contractor
to identify annual and multi-year
savings that exceed the cost of the
contractor’s service?

contests.title: City of Austin Proposition J — Technical charter corrections

provenance.quote:
Shall the City Charter be amended
to make non-substantive corrections
of typographical errors, punctuation,
and sentence structure, and to
change or remove language that is
moot or unenforceable because it
has been superseded by state law
or by a final court order?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Requires an Independent Affordability and Efficiency Initiative regularly and before any tax-rate-increase election. The independent contractor must identify annual and multi-year savings exceeding the cost of its services.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Adopt the review and savings-identification requirements.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not adopt this charter amendment.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Makes nonsubstantive corrections to typographical errors, punctuation and sentence structure, and changes or removes language that is moot or unenforceable because state law or a final court order has superseded it.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Adopt the proposed technical and conforming changes.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not adopt this charter amendment.
